title: Fix WhatsApp CTA link not opening on landing page

requirements.text: Fix the product card “Order on WhatsApp” call-to-action so the WhatsApp link reliably opens when clicked. Ensure the clickable element is a real anchor (<a>) with the WhatsApp URL in its href (not a nested/overlaid element that can block navigation), and keep the existing WhatsApp deep links exactly as they are in the app (Bike Tyres: https://wa.me/91XXXXXXXXXX, Car Tyres: https://wa.me/919242253234).

quotes: Link is not able to open

acceptanceCriteria: On the landing page, clicking “Order on WhatsApp” for Bike Tyres navigates to https://wa.me/91XXXXXXXXXX (e.g., opens a new tab/window if target=_blank is used).
On the landing page, clicking “Order on WhatsApp” for Car Tyres navigates to https://wa.me/919242253234 (e.g., opens a new tab/window if target=_blank is used).
There is no broken or malformed href (no missing quotes, no stray characters) and the click is not prevented by the component structure/styling.

constraints: Do not change the WhatsApp deep links from the values currently used in the app: Bike Tyres https://wa.me/91XXXXXXXXXX and Car Tyres https://wa.me/919242253234.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only); compose with them or adjust usage from editable components like frontend/src/App.tsx.
Keep the app as a single-page landing page; no new backend functionality is required.
nonGoals: Adding Internet Identity authentication flows or backend features.
Adding analytics, tracking, or link-shortening services.
Changing the site’s visual theme beyond what is required to make the CTA link clickable.
